# F5: post-process and the image pipeline {#sec-fg-post-process}

The engine draws the world, then a stack of full-screen effects, then the HUD.
Script controls the stack only. This page covers the effect lifecycle, the
effect catalogue, the colour and grain parameters, the template reader, and the
world HDR anchors.

## What works

- `ppEffectCreate [name, priority]` builds a named effect at a priority. The
  higher priority draws later, on top of the lower. It returns a handle, or -1
  on failure. {src:cmd:ppEffectCreate}
- `ppEffectAdjust handle [params]` sets the parameter array.
  {src:cmd:ppEffectAdjust}
- `ppEffectCommit handle duration` fades the change over the time.
  {src:cmd:ppEffectCommit}
- `ppEffectEnable handle bool` switches the effect on and off and keeps the
  handle alive. {src:cmd:ppEffectEnable}
- `ppEffectDestroy handle` frees the handle. {src:cmd:ppEffectDestroy}
- The creatable catalogue holds nine effects: RadialBlur, ChromAberration,
  WetDistortion, ColorCorrections, DynamicBlur, FilmGrain, ColorInversion,
  SSAO and Resolution. {src:adr:ADR-010}
- `ColorCorrections` takes seven elements in this order: brightness, contrast,
  offset, the blend vector, the colorize vector, the weight vector and the
  radial vector. {src:cfg:CfgPostProcessTemplates.Default.colorCorrections}
- The base-game `Default` template holds six elements and omits the radial
  vector. The engine treats the missing vector as the default.
  {src:pbo:Addons/functions_f.pbo:3553}
- `FilmGrain` sets the grain with `intensity` and `sharpness`, plus a grain
  size, two intensity endpoints and a monochromatic flag. The engine defaults
  are 0.005, 1.25, 2.01, 0.75, 1.0 and 0. {src:adr:ADR-014}
- `CfgPostProcessTemplates` holds one class per named template. The base game
  ships `Default`, `Survive`, `RealIsBrown`, `BlackAndWhite` and
  `Mediterranean`. The curator module `ModulePostprocess_F` calls
  `BIS_fnc_modulePostprocess`, which reads the named template and applies it to
  the camera. {src:script:docs/wiki/research/post-process-template-reference.md}
- The engine reads the world HDR pipeline from `HDRNewPars`. It carries the
  bloom, the tonemap curve, the eye-adaptation gains and the night shift
  aperture. {src:cfg:CfgWorlds.HDRNewPars}
- The engine reads `DOFPars` to place the NVG focal plane.
  {src:cfg:CfgWorlds.DOFPars}

## What does not work

- A scriptable sharpen filter. The engine has no `Sharpen` effect. Scene
  sharpening is the video option "Sharpen Filter", and a mod cannot set a video
  option. {src:adr:ADR-010}
- A second depth of field. `DepthOfField` is one engine handle, and the NVG
  tube model owns it. {src:script:addons/nightvision/functions/fnc_applyNVGTubeModel.sqf}
- A run-time change to `HDRNewPars`. The engine reads it at world load, and no
  script command reaches the same stage. {src:script:docs/wiki/research/engine-hdr-and-night-ceiling.md}
- A preset in the video menu. A mod can declare a template class and extend the
  curator list. It cannot add a preset to the engine video menu, which is
  engine UI data. {src:script:docs/wiki/research/post-process-template-reference.md}
- A custom effect type or a custom shader. `ppEffectCreate` accepts the nine
  named effects only. {src:script:docs/wiki/research/video-option-ceiling.md}

## Limitations

- The effect count and the draw order are fixed by the priority. Two owners
  must not share one priority. The registry bumps the priority until the engine
  returns a handle the registry does not hold.
  {src:script:addons/lib/functions/fnc_createPPEffect.sqf}
- `ColorCorrections` is a single-slot effect. One owner holds the visible
  value. Severe weather wins the weather slot, and snow blindness holds it when
  severe weather is clear. {src:script:addons/vision/functions/vision/fnc_managePostProcess.sqf}
- The base-grade tone curve is read at world load and cached. AEE reads the
  vanilla `Default` anchor once per session and falls back to the neutral triple
  when the read fails. {src:adr:ADR-014}
- The NVG depth of field is one handle. Its blur is a script approximation,
  because the engine does not document the parameter unit.
  {src:script:tools/validation/validate_dof.py}

## Breaks visually

- A `ColorCorrections` or `ChromAberration` array of the wrong length throws.
  A six-element `ChromAberration` array logs the "6 elements provided, 3
  expected" error class and no effect is applied.
  {src:script:addons/vision/functions/vision/fnc_managePostProcess.sqf}
- A fight over the single weather slot. Two writers flicker the picture. The
  arbiter gives the slot one owner per tick.
  {src:script:addons/vision/functions/vision/fnc_managePostProcess.sqf}
- An over-bright tone. A large brightness or a lifted black point washes the
  image out. The grade may only deepen the black point and raise the contrast.
  {src:adr:ADR-014}
- A world anchor outside the class chain is inert. A direct `CfgWorlds` child
  is never read, so the HDR values never reach the frame.
  {src:probe:P84}
